☁️ Sync
Checking sync status...
Set up sync — pick ONE of these:
🔑 This is my FIRST device
Paste a GitHub token and you're done — the app builds its own cloud storage automatically. Get one free token (one time, ever) at github.com/settings/tokens — check the gist box only.
GitHub Token
📲 I already set up ANOTHER device
On that device, open Sync → "Add Another Device". Then either scan its QR code with this phone's camera (nothing to type), or copy the pairing code there and paste it below.
Pairing Code
📲 Add Another Device
New phone or iPad: scan this QR with its camera — the app opens already connected. Computer: copy the pairing code and paste it into that Sync screen. This code contains your sync key — only share it with your own devices.
Pairing code (tap to select):
⚠️ This is your GitHub token in disguise. Do not screenshot, photograph or paste it anywhere but your own device's Sync screen. Hide it again when you're done.
Advanced: link by Gist ID / change token (old method)
Paste your OTHER device's Gist ID here
Makes a brand-new cloud backup from this device. Your old one is left on GitHub, untouched. Other devices must re-pair afterwards.
Wipes every job, photo, punch item and note stored on this phone and unlinks the cloud file, so your next push creates a brand-new one. Your GitHub token can be kept. This cannot be undone, and it does NOT delete old gists on GitHub — remove those yourself at gist.github.com.
Clears only this phone's sync settings (token, cloud link, remembered pairing). Your jobs, photos and finances are not touched.
🗑 Recently Deleted
Anything you delete is kept here for 30 days. Restoring puts it back on every device.
📊 Storage
Re-saves anything that was stored uncompressed, at a size where permit and receipt text stays readable. Smaller backups, faster pushes. Push afterwards so every device gets the smaller copies.
Text & Button Size
Bigger text AND bigger buttons everywhere, from 85% to 180% in small steps. This setting is per-device. On an iPad each size goes further still, since the same text reads smaller on a bigger screen viewed from farther away.
Your Name
There's no login system — this just labels the EOD Reports, Photos, and Expenses YOU create on this device, so whoever pulls this data later can see who submitted what.
Hourly Rate (optional)
Used to estimate labor $ on the Time Clock. Leave blank to just track hours.
Your Email (for EOD alerts)
When you save an EOD Report for a job with open punch items, this opens a pre-filled email to this address listing what's still open — you just tap Send in your mail app. Leave blank to turn this off.
Device Passcode
A soft lock for this phone only — not real security. Change it here, or use "Forgot passcode" on the lock screen.
Face ID Unlock
Checking this device…
Export Data (CSV)
Download a spreadsheet-ready file — opens in Excel, Google Sheets, or Numbers.
📁 Google Drive Backup
A second, independent backup — a snapshot of everything, saved to a private file in your own Google Drive. One-time setup required (see the setup guide); after that, just tap a button.
